author: JoeBiden
text:
Proud to cast my ballot earlier today in the Delaware primary election. 

American democracy begins and ends at the ballot box. There is no more important civic duty nor fundamental right to be defended. Voting defines our freedom and makes everything possible.

Today, on National Voter Registration Day, I hope every American will take a moment to make sure you are registered, ensure your information is up to date, and make a plan to vote this November.

Do it at http://IWillVote.com.

The work to secure our democracy and protect our fundamental rights and freedoms is not over in this country. Each generation must join the work to preserve our democratic values and norms.

Start today. Get engaged. And together, we'll ensure American democracy lasts another 250 years and beyond.
